residentEvil.title: Resident Evil (PlayStation, 1996)
residentEvil.evidence: Chris's mansion entry has a real corridor, a door transition, a new room, and a threat revealed after moving farther. The picture shows when room and input cues return, not the internal loading completion signal.

comparison.teachingRole: Contrast necessary or meaningful wait with idle time where no new choice or clue is visible. Model the internal loading-complete boundary separately rather than guessing it from a retail capture.
